rules.description: Property must be located in England or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: HM Land Registry only deals with property in England and Wales
rules.alternative_service: scotland: Registers of Scotland, northern-ireland: Land and Property Services

rules.description: Property must be unregistered or ownership is changing
rules.reason_if_failed: Property is already registered and ownership is not changing

rules.description: Leasehold property must have more than 7 years remaining on the lease
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not usually need to register leasehold property with 7 years or less on the lease

rules.description: Applicant must provide valid deeds or evidence of ownership
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide property deeds or other evidence of ownership

rules.description: Identity must be verified if not using a legal professional
rules.reason_if_failed: You must verify your identity if applying without a solicitor or conveyancer

rules.description: Land Charges Department search must be completed for unregistered property
rules.reason_if_failed: You must apply for a search from the Land Charges Department before first registration

rules.description: Application must be submitted within priority period after completion
rules.reason_if_failed: Application must be submitted promptly after completion to maintain priority

edge_cases.description: Property is agricultural land requiring Rural Land Register
edge_cases.action: Must also register with Rural Land Register. Provide additional documentation.

edge_cases.description: Property has unregistered interests (short-term lease, right of occupation)
edge_cases.action: Complete disclosable interests form and include detailed guidance documentation.

edge_cases.description: Property owned before 1990 and never mortgaged
edge_cases.action: Voluntary registration. May require additional historical documentation.

edge_cases.description: Complex ownership structure or inheritance dispute
edge_cases.action: Strongly recommend professional legal representation. Hand off to solicitor/conveyancer.

edge_cases.description: Leasehold property requiring certified lease copy
edge_cases.action: Must include certified copy of the lease with application.
